# dsh-im-union

A union IM bridge for DeepSeek Harness — a clean-room reimplementation merging the capability sets of xmanrui/dsh-im and MichengAI/dsh-im-connect, with no source copied from either.

## Status

**0.4.7**: all 15 channel adapters (12 platforms including email; WeCom/DingTalk/QQ each contribute two: bot + self-built app or notify tier), the cross-version narrow waist, session engine, approval/question IM loop, multi-account management, the native Tasks/Channels sidebar split, the IM-tuned agent preset with reply sanitisation, svg-fence-to-image rendering and `/relay` final-answer mirroring are delivered (728 unit tests; host-farm smoke green on 0.1.2 / 0.1.5 / 0.1.7 / 0.2.1 lines; verified end to end on a real desktop profile with browser inspection up to 0.4.6). Outstanding real-device acceptance items are registered in CHANGELOG.

Highlights:

- **Channels**: WeChat (official iLink QR bind), Feishu/Lark (long-connection, streaming cards, optional voice tier requiring system ffmpeg), Telegram, Discord, WeCom intelligent bot, DingTalk (stream + AI Card, plus a custom-robot notify tier), QQ official bot (plus notify tier), Slack (Socket Mode, zero SDK), WhatsApp (Baileys QR pairing; the dependency ships as an optionalDependency), Matrix, iMessage (macOS only), WeCom self-built app (signed callback webhook), Email (IMAP/SMTP thread routing), and more; unconfigured channels load nothing (lazy imports).
- **In-chat loop**: 25 commands (`/help /status /new /stop /steer /model(s) /reasoning /preset(s) /session(s) /workspace(s) /fork /rename /queue /mute /unbind /goal /delivery /export /speak /relay /menu`); tool approvals and agent questions answered in the originating chat (deny-by-default, 5-minute expiry, initiator only).
- **IM-friendly output**: a native sidebar that splits **Tasks / Channels** into two self-owned tabs (wraps the host's official task tree, IM sessions filtered out of Tasks; stands down entirely when another plugin already owns the slot); an `im-concise` agent preset whose complete-mode persona keeps rich-structure injections (GenUI fences, raw HTML) out of text-only chats, with reply sanitisation as a backstop; ```svg fences rendered to PNG and sent as images (degrades to plain text when no renderer is present); a model allowlist as an out-of-channel guardrail; and `/relay` mirroring of each turn's final answer to notify channels (DingTalk group webhook / QQ active push), addressable by account ID **or** alias.
- **Cross-version**: settings surface auto-adapts gen1/gen2/gen3; capability probing only, never version branches.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-im-union@latest --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
```

Then add accounts in the "IM union bridge" panel: most channels use credential binding (secrets are one-way into the vault and never echoed back); WeChat/WhatsApp use QR pairing; the WeCom self-built app channel requires pointing your callback URL (`/api/dsh-im-union/wecom-app/callback`) in its console. See `SECURITY.md` for the non-negotiable privacy red lines and `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` for the clean-room provenance.

**Install prerequisites**:

- The WhatsApp channel's `@whiskeysockets/baileys` is declared in `optionalDependencies` and installs with the package; if skipped while offline, the channel fails fast with a clear "not installed" message instead of crashing.
- The Feishu voice tier requires system `ffmpeg` on PATH (the transcoding binary is not shipped; it is only invoked when the voice tier is enabled).
- The iMessage channel is macOS only.
